notes.IDR_FX_crosses: FX_IDC:EURIDR/AUDIDR/CHFIDR/SGDIDR/JPYIDR/GBPIDR have isolated bad raw data points (e.g. value=4.0 when level should be ~14000) causing extreme log return spikes. These are source data artifacts; ret_type=log is correct for FX. Fix at ingest/raw-clean layer, not ret_type.
notes.RRPONTSYD: ON RRP Usage: ret=diff is the least-bad option given near-zero base in early history (yoy divides by ~0); diff values in USD billions remain large at extremes but are interpretable.
notes.WM1NS: M1 yoy spike to 370% in 2021 reflects a real FRED definitional change (savings accounts reclassified into M1), not a data error. ret=yoy is correct; downstream users should be aware of the structural break.
notes.STLFSI4: Max weekly diff of +-2.2 is a real COVID-era spike in this z-score index. ret=diff is appropriate for a dimensionless financial stress index.
notes.LQD_HYG_IEF_spread: HYG-IEF and LQD-IEF are price-spread proxy series. Max of +-18 occurs during COVID credit blowout and is real. ret=diff (change in spread proxy) is appropriate.
notes.BAML_OAS: BAMLH0A0HYM2 and BAMLC0A0CM raw data appears truncated to ~3 years (157 weekly obs). OAS spreads are measured in percentage points; diff (change in spread level) is standard market practice, not yoy ratio.
